title: Police Step In When Creep Won’t Leave Girl Alone (Uncut)
description:
On November 5th, 2022, officers responded to an altercation where a male had punched a female and was attempting to restrain her.  The male was soon transferred to jail for further processing. The male tried to bite one of the officers and kept escalating the situation. While being transported to the jail, the male started rapping. The male was charged with assault, resisting arrest, unlawful restraint and aggravated assault.
